# COMP3020 Group Project - Bluesky: "climate change" vs "climate crisis"
# Hypothesis Testing and Text/Content Analysis and Visualisation
# Written by: Pushti Patel

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Load cleaned data from Part 2.1
posts <- readRDS("posts_clean.rds")

# Quick check of variables
summary(posts$like_count)
table(posts$framing)

"02_hypothesis_tet.R"

2.2 hypothesis testing

# Part 1: Research Question
# Do posts that use the phrase "Climate Change" receive a higher engagement rate than the posts that use the phrase "Climate Change"?

# Split into two different groups
likes_crisis <- posts |> filter(framing == "crisis") |> pull(like_count)
likes_change <- posts |> filter(framing == "change") |> pull(like_count)

# Visual check (skewed distribution)
ggplot(posts, aes(x = like_count, fill = framing)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 50)) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Likes by Framing",
       x = "Like Count", y = "Frequency")

# ---- Wilcoxon Rank-Sum Test (non-parametric)
wilcox_result <- wilcox.test(likes_crisis, likes_change,
                             alternative = "greater") # crisis > change
wilcox_result
